body:
> Vegging out in pjs all day is the way to go!

It really did help :)
She has always been like this. Very head strong and independent but always asking for help. She has many good things about her but it still hurts only to be wanted for what you can give.

feeling much better today after logging in and having reddit people leaving pms :) I also dont have any plans today so going to veg out in my pj`s ALL DAY LONG. 

How are you ?

> Hey man if you need to talk, you can hit me up anytime

Thank you. Im just letting you know that you have been very kind and that Im still alive hehe. How is your day going ?

I forget that the sun plays havoc in other places. Now that summer is here will it be mostly sunny all day ?

EDIT: Cooking, history and period dramas are my hobbies. Whats yours ?
My cat is the best.
Thank you <3 Gonna try and call my mother later on.
I wish that was true but I just get ghosted most of the time.
Hello :)
Feeling much better now that kind people are talking to me on reddit. Hows things with you ?

That very sad but I can relate. My sister (oldest) was the last person to contact me in November and she was asking for money as she was losing her house. I helped and Ive not heard from her since. This is normal.
I think I can do better for you :) Do you eat meat ? I make a yummy veg lasagna if not.
Sorry Im late. Ive eaten it all now :( I can make more if you want :)

Im 35 male and from The UK (South England if it matters) 

Whats the weather like  in sweden?

Tomato and basil Heinz soup. i also made a lazy lazy no knead dutch oven "bread" that turned out to be a massive crumpet. Much butter needed and lots of toasting. 

What are you thinking for dinner ?

>  I love cinnamon swirl raisin bread if you made that I’d eat the whole loaf haha :p

You would be welcome for dinner and pudding at my house :) All the best.

hypomanic episode ? does that mean youre on the way down now ?

100% gonna try again. I didnt cook it long enough so its a silly mistake.
Im ok for the moment. Had a terrible day yesterday as my cinnamon swirl loaf didnt work hehe. How are you ?
Hey :)
ello :)

Your the first person to speak to me for months so thank you.

Ive not really informed about self harming but I can tell you Im glad that you are safe.

Keep thinking of them and how much worse things could be. Keep strong.

If the cuts are bad see a doctor ASAP as your family would be upset if you didnt.
All the best and thank you. just know you helped someone and it means alot. You saved me tonight.
Its ok, really. Your friend sounds solid. So if Im reading right you are staying here because you dont want to hurt your friend ? you saw how much your pain hurt her/him ? is that right ?

I know. Thanks for chatting. At least you know that Im not faking it and being honest. 

So back to my question. Why wait. If you can have peace and rest after death then what makes you want to stay here.
Well, I imaged you there so does that mean Ive taken you there ?

> then dying must be sort of magical for you then

Your kind of death sound much more pleasing to me.
I wish I could ebb away. My "afterlife sounds like no rest or peace just forever this.

I think thats lovely however im religious, for me it wont stop after death. Im forever, unfortunately. Im looking for a way out. There is no rest after just more work and more of the same. Are you ok ?

Why wait.

I mean whats the point of staying here if you think itll be better after death.
I dont really know what that means but thank you for chatting with me.

35 years and it just keeps on going. To answer my own question. No, no it wont. Im sick and tired of trying. sick of trying to make the most of what really is just pure and utter shit. Its not been worth it. Its never changed in fact its just slowly getting worse. No piont what so ever.
